caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a pattern of floral and geometric elements. The design is primarily composed of two colors: dark blue and red, set against an off-white background. The main central section displays large, dense, symmetrical blue floral motifs with some small red vertical accents, arranged in a repeating horizontal band. Above and below the central band are smaller horizontal strips with alternating blue floral and diamond shapes; the upper band has diamond outlines with smaller blue florals within, while the lower band consists of a border made up of smaller blue flower-like forms, interspersed with straight red accents. The right and left edges of the design are framed with bold red floral patterns, featuring stylized flowers, stems, and leaves, whereas the upper left corner of the design is folded over, revealing a blue and red backing. The composition follows a grid-like layout with clear separation between each patterned section. The lines and edges of the motifs have a slightly jagged, unfinished quality, and the colors are solid and opaque, with little shading or gradient.
title: Coverlet
